content: 1. The metabolism of flibanserin is significantly influenced by the hepatic and intestinal enzyme CYP3A4. Co-administration with drugs that affect this enzyme requires caution and close monitoring. 2. Serotonin modulators may enhance dopamine blockade, potentially increasing the risk of neuroleptic malignant syndrome (NMS). Symptoms of NMS include hyperthermia, muscle rigidity, and autonomic dysfunction. 3. Antipsychotics may amplify the serotonergic effects of serotonin modulators, which could lead to serotonin syndrome. Symptoms of serotonin syndrome include mental status changes, autonomic instability, and neuromuscular hyperactivity. 4. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor can decrease the levels or effects of flibanserin by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 5. Strong CYP3A4 inducers can substantially reduce systemic exposure to flibanserin. Monitor closely for therapeutic efficacy. 6. Co-administration of lumateperone and flibanserin increases sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 7. Lurasidone increases the levels or effects of flibanserin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 8. Flibanserin and lurasidone both increase sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 9. Flibanserin increases the levels of mavorizafor by inhibiting the P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporter. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 10. Co-administration of flibanserin with P-gp inhibitors may require dose adjustments of mavorizafor. Monitor closely for adverse effects. 11. Meclizine and flibanserin both increase sedation. Use caution and monitor closely. 12. Mefloquine increases the levels or effects of flibanserin by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use caution and monitor closely. 13. Co-administration of multiple weak CYP3A4 inhibitors with flibanserin may increase the risk of adverse effects. Monitor closely. 14. Meperidine and flibanserin both increase sedation. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. 15. The risk of sedation is heightened when flibanserin is co-administered with other CNS depressants. Monitor closely. 16.
